extension.name: Tab Refresh
extension.description: Adds a refresh button to each tab on the contact summary page, so a tab's content (Activities, Contributions, Relationships, SearchKit and Afform tabs, etc.) can be reloaded without reloading the whole page.

compatibility.comments: Semantic versioning. For example, compatibility with "6.1" implies compatibility with "6.2".

php_compatibility.comments: Listed versions. For example, specify both "8.1" and "8.2".

smarty_compatibility.comments: Listed versions. For example, specify both "4" and "5".

extension.comments: No configuration needed: enable the extension and each contact summary tab gets a refresh button. Does not override any core file; it builds on the public CRM.tabHeader API from core's TabHeader.js.
